title: Back to the Game
staging:
Scene 24 — Back to the Game

19:30–20:00 · 30 sec · Resistance hideout

The crew returns home, collapses onto the couch, and turns on CatStation 5. Grand Theft Kitty VI resumes at the Great Dog National Bank heist.

Shots: Wide hideout → controllers being picked up → TV loading screen → Trixie's face → group couch wide → final TV close-up.
